masscal.title: Title of the calibration check panel; {file} = file name.
masscal.sum: Summary line; {n} = contaminant ions found, {off} = robust offset in ppm with sign, {spread} = spread in ppm.
masscal.sum.few: Summary when there are few ions; {n} = ions found, {min} = minimum to estimate the error.
masscal.trend: Error trend; {mz} = ppm per 100 m/z, {rt} = ppm per minute (signed), {model} = name of the fitted model.
masscal.trend.mz: Error trend with m/z; {mz} = ppm per 100 m/z (signed), {model} = name of the fitted model.
masscal.thr: Label of the threshold field; {input} = numeric field in ppm.
masscal.minint: Label of the minimum intensity field; {input} = numeric field.
masscal.plot.desc: Short description of a plot; {title} = title, {n} = number of ions, {a} and {b} = minimum and maximum error in ppm.
